newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia Pacific debuts at 4.30 rgt.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia Pacific debuts at 4.30 rgt.

text.p: Shares of property developer Malaysian Pacific Land Bhd debuted on the main board of the Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange on Monday at 4.30 ringgit against an offer price of 2.95 ringgit.
The company had offered a total of 12.38 million shares for sale.

Malaysia Pacific Land said in its prospectus of December 30 1996, that its forecasted net profit for the year ending June 30 1997 would be 23.89 million ringgit, compared to 7.3 million in the preceding year.
The project is expected to generate around 1.61 billion ringgit in revenue over a 10 to 12 year period, the company said.
The company is in the process of developing an 875.94 acre (354.49 hectares) land bank in the southern port city of Johor Baru into a residential, commercial and industrial complex.
